title: Not a git repository
detail: There is no history to mine, no baseline to revert to, and no way to tell what changed when. Every other safety net in an audit assumes git.

title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML in puffy-web/src/components/ui/chart.tsx:83
detail: Safe only if the HTML is sanitised on the way IN. Check there is an allowlist, and that it runs at save time rather than at render time.
